question: Which of the 58 previously unclassified direct predicate sites have an exact local literal Wonder argument, and does an additional index-three consumer exist?

scope.boundary: This result classifies nearest straight-line local argument writes in 58 selected caller windows, maps one additional index-three modifier, and bounds an exact split-constant search for two Stonehenge slot words. Complete caller control flow, wider argument provenance, all effects, aliases, computed claim-slot readers, and runtime behavior remain outside the result.

dependencies.use: Supplies the accepted 64-site raw inventory and the six already classified city-update argument sites.
Binds the existing Temple contribution, index-three predicate, ownership gates, and city-local selection limit.
Provides the eight-byte claim-slot layout and table base used to select index-three owner and city words.
Binds normalized Wonder index three to Stonehenge.
Identifies 0x82CB44E0 as the accepted AI choice evaluation owner without assigning this local modifier a complete score formula.

localArguments.qualification: Each recorded li r3 instruction is the nearest r3 write in its selected local straight-line sequence before the direct call. Its immediate and register fields were independently decoded from the supported image. The other selected lookbacks stop at the listed control-flow boundary. These local sequences do not prove whole-function dominance, reachability, caller frequency, or a valid supported index range.

additionalStonehengeConsumer.otherArguments: 0x82CB59C4 copies r20 to r4; 0x82CB59C8 loads r5 from stack +0x234. Their wider provenance is not assigned here.
additionalStonehengeConsumer.modifier: 0x82CB59D4 tests the predicate return for zero, and 0x82CB59D8 skips to 0x82CB59E8 when zero. A nonzero result reaches 0x82CB59DC..0x82CB59E4, which adds signed r31 divided by two, truncated toward zero, to the retained r31 value.
additionalStonehengeConsumer.qualification: This is an additional local Stonehenge-conditioned arithmetic consumer in the accepted AI owner, distinct from the Temple-conditioned city-yield writer. The r31 input, final score formula, resulting decision, and runtime effect remain unclassified.

remainingArguments.qualification: The selected backward read stops at these local control-flow instructions before establishing a straight-line r3 write. No literal index, generic index range, or Stonehenge exclusion is claimed for these thirteen sites.

exactSlotMaterialization.method: A raw aligned lis/addi or lis/ori candidate search over initialized memory used these two exact targets, an eight-word lookahead, and a cap of 32 candidates.
exactSlotMaterialization.qualification: No matching exact split-constant materializer was emitted. This does not exclude table-base-plus-offset, aliases, loaded pointers, computed indexing, indirect reads, other materialization forms, or claim-slot consumers.

coverageConsequences.result: Together with the six accepted city-update arguments, 51 of the 64 inventory sites now have selected local literal sequences. Two select index three: the Temple contribution and this AI-owner modifier. The other 49 local literal sequences select different values, including two value-33 sequences outside the predicate's accepted upper guard. Thirteen sites remain at control-flow boundaries.
coverageConsequences.qualification: Literal discrimination is not full effect coverage. Suppressing only the Temple contribution would leave the additional selected index-three arithmetic consumer; disabling every indexed predicate or ordinary claim state is not justified.

runtimeObservation.qualification: No AI decision, native suppression, culture result, mod activation, ownership change, or gameplay behavior was observed or changed.

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only DumpMemoryWords invocation selected 58 radius-16 windows, emitting 1,914 rows covering 1,724 unique words. Every row matched the supported flat image. Exact generated headers identified 26 caller owners; 143 selected backward-window instruction rows corroborated local argument writes or the first control-flow boundary. The selected AI post-call window corroborated the zero-return branch and retained arithmetic. One additional foreground read-only exact split-constant query emitted zero candidates without truncation.
currentEvidence.qualification: The raw context bounds include adjacent words; promoted argument facts use exact selected caller windows. Generated code corroborates the supported image and supplies useful instruction locators, rather than independent execution authority. The split search covers only its stated exact pattern.

guards: Do not treat the Temple contribution as Stonehenge's only native consumer: the selected AI-owner modifier also uses index three.
Do not infer a final culture formula, AI choice, exact score semantics, or runtime benefit from the local r31 arithmetic.
Do not infer argument values for the thirteen control-flow-boundary sites or treat local literal discrimination as complete caller reachability.
Do not equate a zero exact-slot candidate result with absence of computed or aliased claim-slot consumers.
Do not suppress all indexed Wonder queries or mutate ordinary claim ownership to implement one Wonder's replacement effects.
conclusion: The 58 selected lookbacks contain 45 verified local literal arguments and thirteen unresolved control-flow boundaries. One additional literal-three call conditionally adds signed half of retained r31 to that value in the accepted AI evaluation owner. The exact split-constant search for the two index-three slot words emitted no candidates, while computed and aliased claim-slot readers remain outside that negative result. Complete native replacement and runtime acceptance remain unclosed.
